DELETE /customers/{id}.title: Delete customer
DELETE /customers/{id}.description: Permanently delete a customer by id. Destructive: past transactions are kept, but the customer can no longer be charged or subscribed.

DELETE /webhooks/{id}.title: Delete webhook endpoint
DELETE /webhooks/{id}.description: Remove a webhook endpoint by id so lomi. stops sending event notifications to its URL. Destructive and immediate.

GET /accounts/balance.title: Get account balance
GET /accounts/balance.description: Return your current available and pending balances per currency. Use to see how much can be paid out right now.

GET /accounts/balance/breakdown.title: Get balance breakdown
GET /accounts/balance/breakdown.description: Break the balance into available, pending, and reserved components per currency. Use for reconciliation and cash-flow reporting.

GET /accounts/balance/{currency}.title: Check balance for a currency
GET /accounts/balance/{currency}.description: Return the available balance for a single currency (e.g. XOF). Call before creating a payout to confirm sufficient funds.

GET /checkout-sessions.title: List checkout sessions
GET /checkout-sessions.description: List hosted checkout sessions with status (open, completed, expired). Filter to find a session or audit conversion.

GET /checkout-sessions/{id}.title: Get checkout session
GET /checkout-sessions/{id}.description: Retrieve one checkout session by id, including status, amount, and resulting transaction. Use to verify whether a customer completed payment.

GET /customers.title: List customers
GET /customers.description: List customers with pagination and search. Use to find a customer before charging, refunding, or inspecting their history.

GET /customers/{id}.title: Get customer
GET /customers/{id}.description: Retrieve one customer's profile (email, name, metadata) by id.

GET /customers/{id}/portal-audit.title: Get customer portal audit log
GET /customers/{id}/portal-audit.description: Return the audit trail of a customer's self-service actions in the billing portal (plan changes, payment-method updates). Use for support investigations.

GET /customers/{id}/transactions.title: List a customer's transactions
GET /customers/{id}/transactions.description: List every payment made by one customer. Use to review payment history or investigate a disputed charge.

GET /coupons.title: List discount coupons
GET /coupons.description: List discount coupons with their value, limits, and status. Use to find a coupon or audit active promotions.

GET /coupons/{id}.title: Get discount coupon
GET /coupons/{id}.description: Retrieve one coupon by id, including discount value, currency, and redemption limits.

GET /coupons/{id}/performance.title: Get coupon performance
GET /coupons/{id}/performance.description: Return redemption count and revenue impact for a coupon. Use to measure how a promotion is performing.

GET /disputes.title: List disputes
GET /disputes.description: List chargebacks and disputes raised against your payments, with status, reason, and deadline. Use to triage disputes needing evidence.

GET /disputes/{id}.title: Get dispute
GET /disputes/{id}.description: Retrieve one dispute by id with its status, reason, amount, and response deadline.

GET /logs.title: List logs
GET /logs.description: `type` is required: api_request, api_error, webhook_delivery, or activity. Webhook debugging can also use lomi_webhooks deliveries/retry. Use to debug API calls or trace events.

GET /logs/{id}.title: Get a log entry
GET /logs/{id}.description: Retrieve one log entry by id. Pass `type` to select the log stream. Returns 404 if it doesn't exist or is outside your organization scope.

GET /merchants/{id}.title: Get merchant details
GET /merchants/{id}.description: Return the merchant profile plus headline metrics (MRR, ARR, LTV). Metrics refresh daily and on subscription changes.

GET /merchants/{id}/arr.title: Get merchant ARR
GET /merchants/{id}/arr.description: Return the merchant's annual recurring revenue. Use for subscription revenue reporting.

GET /merchants/{id}/balance.title: Get merchant balance
GET /merchants/{id}/balance.description: Return the merchant's account balance for a currency, scoped to a merchant id.

GET /merchants/{id}/mrr.title: Get merchant MRR
GET /merchants/{id}/mrr.description: Return the merchant's monthly recurring revenue. Use for subscription revenue reporting.

GET /meters.title: List meters
GET /meters.description: List usage meters (billable metrics) defined for usage-based products.

GET /meters/{id}.title: Get meter
GET /meters/{id}.description: Retrieve one usage meter by id, including its event code and aggregation method.

GET /meters/{id}/balances/{customerId}.title: Get a customer's meter balance
GET /meters/{id}/balances/{customerId}.description: Return aggregated consumed units for a meter and customer. Use to see current usage before billing.

GET /organizations/radar-settings.title: Get fraud (Radar) settings
GET /organizations/radar-settings.description: Return your organization's Radar fraud-protection rules and thresholds.

GET /organizations.title: List organizations
GET /organizations.description: List the organizations accessible to your API key.

GET /organizations/{id}.title: Get organization
GET /organizations/{id}.description: Retrieve one organization's profile and settings by id.

GET /organizations/metrics.title: Get organization metrics
GET /organizations/metrics.description: Return aggregate business metrics (volume, revenue, customers) for your organization. Use for dashboards and reporting.

GET /payment-links.title: List payment links
GET /payment-links.description: List reusable payment links with status. Use to find or audit shareable payment URLs.

GET /payment-links/{id}.title: Get payment link
GET /payment-links/{id}.description: Retrieve one payment link by id, including its URL, amount, and status.

GET /payment-requests.title: List payment requests
GET /payment-requests.description: List one-off payment requests sent to customers, with status and amount. Distinct from invoices (lomi_invoices).

GET /payment-requests/{id}.title: Get payment request
GET /payment-requests/{id}.description: Retrieve one payment request by id, including amount, customer, and whether it has been paid.

GET /payouts.title: List payouts
GET /payouts.description: List payouts (funds moved out to your bank/mobile account) with status and amount.

GET /payouts/{id}.title: Get payout
GET /payouts/{id}.description: Retrieve one payout by id, including status, destination, and amount.

GET /products.title: List products
GET /products.description: List catalog products with their prices. Use to find a product before creating a checkout or subscription.

GET /products/{id}.title: Get product
GET /products/{id}.description: Retrieve one product by id, including its prices and metadata.

GET /providers.title: List payment providers
GET /providers.description: Return connection status for each payment provider (Wave, MTN, Orange, card) configured for your organization.

GET /refunds.title: List refunds
GET /refunds.description: List refunds issued against your payments, with status and amount.

GET /refunds/{id}.title: Get refund
GET /refunds/{id}.description: Retrieve one refund by id, including status, amount, and the original transaction.

GET /risk-assessments.title: List risk assessments
GET /risk-assessments.description: List Radar fraud risk assessments for payments, with score and outcome. Use to review flagged transactions.

GET /risk-assessments/{id}.title: Get risk assessment
GET /risk-assessments/{id}.description: Retrieve one payment's fraud risk assessment by id, including score and triggered rules.

GET /settlements.title: List settlement periods
GET /settlements.description: List settlement periods: completed payment totals grouped by availability date and currency. Each settlement_id is {currency}:{YYYY-MM-DD} (UTC).

GET /settlements/{id}/transactions.title: List transactions in a settlement
GET /settlements/{id}/transactions.description: List the transactions included in one settlement period (settlement_id {currency}:{date}). Use to reconcile a payout against underlying payments.

GET /settlements/instant/{id}.title: Get an instant settlement
GET /settlements/instant/{id}.description: Retrieve one Nitro instant-settlement request by id, including mode, fee, net amount, and status.

GET /subscriptions.title: List subscriptions
GET /subscriptions.description: List subscriptions with status (active, canceled, past_due). Filter to audit recurring billing.

GET /customers/{id}/subscriptions.title: List a customer's subscriptions
GET /customers/{id}/subscriptions.description: List all subscriptions for one customer. Use before changing or canceling their plan.

GET /subscriptions/{id}.title: Get subscription
GET /subscriptions/{id}.description: Retrieve one subscription by id, including plan, status, and current period.

GET /transactions.title: List transactions
GET /transactions.description: List payments across all channels (Wave, MTN, Orange, card). Filter by status, customer, date, or currency to reconcile revenue or find a charge.

GET /transactions/{id}.title: Get transaction
GET /transactions/{id}.description: Retrieve one payment by id, including status, amount, channel, customer, and fees.

GET /usage/entitlements.title: Check an entitlement
GET /usage/entitlements.description: Check whether a customer/subscription is entitled to a feature and its remaining quota. Use to gate access in usage-based plans.

GET /usage/periods.title: List usage billing periods
GET /usage/periods.description: List billing periods for usage-based subscriptions, with accrued charges.

GET /usage/revenue.title: Get usage billing revenue
GET /usage/revenue.description: Return revenue from usage-based billing over time. Use for metered-revenue reporting.

GET /subscriptions/{id}/usage.title: Get subscription usage
GET /subscriptions/{id}/usage.description: Return metered usage for one usage-based subscription in the current period. Use to preview the upcoming invoice.

GET /usage/events.title: List usage events
GET /usage/events.description: List recorded metered usage events. Filter by meter or customer to audit what was billed.

GET /usage/events/{id}.title: Get usage event
GET /usage/events/{id}.description: Retrieve one metered usage event by id.

GET /webhooks/deliveries.title: List webhook deliveries
GET /webhooks/deliveries.description: List outbound webhook delivery attempts with response status and retries. Same stream as lomi_logs action=list type=webhook_delivery. Use retry on a failed delivery id.

GET /webhooks/deliveries/{id}.title: Get webhook delivery
GET /webhooks/deliveries/{id}.description: Retrieve one webhook delivery attempt by id, including request/response and status. Use to debug a specific failed delivery.

GET /webhooks.title: List webhook endpoints
GET /webhooks.description: List configured webhook endpoints with their subscribed events and status.

GET /webhooks/{id}.title: Get webhook endpoint
GET /webhooks/{id}.description: Retrieve one webhook endpoint by id, including URL and subscribed events.

PATCH /customers/{id}.title: Update customer
PATCH /customers/{id}.description: Update a customer's fields (email, name, metadata). Pass the id and only the fields to change in body.

PATCH /meters/{id}.title: Update meter
PATCH /meters/{id}.description: Update a usage meter's configuration (name, aggregation). Pass the id and changed fields.

PATCH /organizations/radar-settings.title: Update fraud (Radar) settings
PATCH /organizations/radar-settings.description: Update your organization's Radar fraud rules and thresholds. Pass only the settings to change.

PATCH /subscriptions/{id}.title: Update subscription
PATCH /subscriptions/{id}.description: Update a subscription's mutable fields (metadata, quantity). To switch plans use change-plan; to end it use cancel.

PATCH /webhooks/{id}.title: Update webhook endpoint
PATCH /webhooks/{id}.description: Update a webhook endpoint's URL or subscribed events. Pass the id and changed fields.

POST /checkout-sessions.title: Create checkout session
POST /checkout-sessions.description: Create a hosted checkout session and get a URL to send the customer for payment. Preferred way for an agent to collect money: set amount/currency or a product, then share the returned link.

POST /customers.title: Create customer
POST /customers.description: Create a customer record (email, name, metadata) to attach future payments and subscriptions to. Returns the new customer id.

POST /customers/{id}/portal.title: Launch customer portal session
POST /customers/{id}/portal.description: Create a short-lived URL letting a customer manage their own subscriptions and payment methods. Share the returned link with the customer.

POST /coupons.title: Create discount coupon
POST /coupons.description: Create a fixed or percentage discount coupon with optional limits. Use to run a promotion; the code is applied at checkout.

POST /meters.title: Create meter
POST /meters.description: Define a billable metric for usage-based products. Usage events with the matching code update this meter's balances.

POST /payment-links.title: Create payment link
POST /payment-links.description: Create a reusable, shareable payment URL for a fixed amount or product. Good for agents: returns a link you can hand to one or many customers.

POST /payment-requests.title: Create payment request
POST /payment-requests.description: Create a one-off payment request for a specific customer and amount, delivered as a payable link. For numbered invoices with PDF, use lomi_invoices.

POST /payouts.title: Create payout
POST /payouts.description: Move available funds out to your configured bank/mobile account. Money-out action: set amount and currency, and check the balance first.

POST /products.title: Create product
POST /products.description: Add a product to your catalog, optionally with an initial price. Do this before creating checkouts or subscriptions that reference it.

POST /products/{id}/prices.title: Add price to product
POST /products/{id}/prices.description: Add a new price (amount, currency, interval) to an existing product. A product can hold several prices.

POST /products/{id}/prices/{priceId}/def.title: Set default product price
POST /products/{id}/prices/{priceId}/def.description: Mark one price as the product's default, used when no price is specified. Pass product id and price id.

POST /refunds.title: Create refund
POST /refunds.description: Refund a payment fully or partially back to the customer. Pass the transaction id and optional amount. Use for returns and support.

POST /settlements/instant.title: Request an instant settlement
POST /settlements/instant.description: Nitro: record a rail fee on an existing payout, or unlock held card funds (advance) up to the org cap. Requires Idempotency-Key. Advance stays off until ops approves a limit.

POST /subscriptions/{id}/cancel.title: Cancel subscription
POST /subscriptions/{id}/cancel.description: Cancel a subscription immediately or at period end. Pass the id; stops future recurring charges.

POST /subscriptions/{id}/change-plan.title: Change subscription plan
POST /subscriptions/{id}/change-plan.description: Move a subscription to a different price/plan with proration. Pass the id and the new price. Use for upgrades and downgrades.

POST /subscriptions/{id}/resume.title: Resume subscription
POST /subscriptions/{id}/resume.description: Reverse a scheduled cancellation so the subscription keeps billing. Pass the id. Only works before the cancellation takes effect.

POST /usage/credits.title: Grant usage credits
POST /usage/credits.description: Grant prepaid credits to a customer that offset future usage-based charges. Use for trials, goodwill, or top-ups.

POST /usage/entitlements.title: Set plan entitlement
POST /usage/entitlements.description: Create or update a feature entitlement (limit/quota) on a plan. Use to define what usage-based plans include.

POST /usage/subscriptions.title: Create usage subscription
POST /usage/subscriptions.description: Enroll a customer on a usage-based product with no upfront charge. Required before metered usage can be billed.

POST /webhooks.title: Create webhook endpoint
POST /webhooks.description: Register a URL to receive event notifications (payments, subscriptions, disputes). Specify the URL and events to subscribe to; returns a signing secret.

POST /webhooks/{id}/test.title: Send test webhook
POST /webhooks/{id}/test.description: Send a sample event to a webhook endpoint to verify it is reachable and handling payloads. Pass the id.

POST /webhooks/{id}/deliveries/{delivery.title: Retry webhook delivery
POST /webhooks/{id}/deliveries/{delivery.description: Re-send a previously failed webhook delivery. Pass the webhook id and the delivery log id from the delivery logs.

GET /api-keys.title: List API keys
GET /api-keys.description: List API keys for the organization. Values are prefix and last4 only; full secrets are never returned.

GET /invoices.title: List invoices
GET /invoices.description: List customer invoices (draft, open, paid, void). Use to collect receivables or send a reminder.

GET /invoices/{id}.title: Get invoice
GET /invoices/{id}.description: Retrieve one invoice including line items, hosted_url (/i/{token}), and amounts due.

GET /invoices/{id}/pdf.title: Download invoice PDF
GET /invoices/{id}/pdf.description: Return hosted_url and download_url for the invoice PDF. Send this link to the human. Stdio MCP and the CLI can save the file locally.

PATCH /invoices/{id}.title: Update invoice
PATCH /invoices/{id}.description: Update a draft invoice (amounts, due date, line items). Paid invoices cannot be rewritten.

POST /invoices.title: Create invoice
POST /invoices.description: Create a customer invoice. Omit password-style fields; send the hosted_url to the human. Poll status until paid.

POST /invoices/{id}/checkout-session.title: Invoice checkout session
POST /invoices/{id}/checkout-session.description: Create or reuse a hosted checkout session so the customer can pay this invoice.

POST /invoices/{id}/finalize.title: Finalize invoice
POST /invoices/{id}/finalize.description: Mark a draft invoice as sent and create a hosted pay link. Does not email the customer.

POST /invoices/{id}/send.title: Send invoice
POST /invoices/{id}/send.description: Finalize the invoice, create a hosted pay link, and queue the invoice email. Send hosted_url to the human if email is unavailable.

POST /invoices/{id}/remind.title: Remind invoice
POST /invoices/{id}/remind.description: Queue a reminder email for a sent or overdue invoice.

POST /invoices/{id}/void.title: Void invoice
POST /invoices/{id}/void.description: Cancel a draft, sent, or overdue invoice.

GET /transactions/{id}/receipt.pdf.title: Download receipt PDF
GET /transactions/{id}/receipt.pdf.description: Return download_url for the transaction receipt PDF. Send the link to the human.

POST /disputes/{id}/evidence.title: Submit dispute evidence
POST /disputes/{id}/evidence.description: Attach written evidence to a card dispute. Confirm facts with the merchant before submitting.

POST /exports.title: Create export
POST /exports.description: Start a CSV or PDF export: transactions_csv, transactions_pdf, customers_csv, customers_pdf, statement_pdf, journal_csv, logs_csv (filters.type), webhook_deliveries_csv, or account_export. Poll list or get until download_url is set.

GET /exports.title: List exports
GET /exports.description: List recent export jobs for the current organization so you can poll without remembering ids.

GET /exports/{id}.title: Get export
GET /exports/{id}.description: Check export job status. When completed, download_url is a short-lived signed URL.

POST /organizations.title: Create organization
POST /organizations.description: Open a new organization and return a secret key once. MCP adopts that key on the session (action=create).

POST /organizations/{id}/keys.title: Use organization
POST /organizations/{id}/keys.description: Mint a secret key for an organization this merchant already belongs to. MCP adopts that key (action=use).

POST /api-keys.title: Create API key
POST /api-keys.description: Create a secret or publishable key. Returns the full secret once. Does not switch the MCP session.

DELETE /api-keys/{id}.title: Revoke API key
DELETE /api-keys/{id}.description: Soft-revoke an API key. Pass the key value or masked prefix.

PATCH /products/{id}.title: Update product
PATCH /products/{id}.description: Update name, description, visibility, images, SKU, or inventory. Product type cannot change after creation.

DELETE /products/{id}.title: Archive product
DELETE /products/{id}.description: Soft-archive a product so it no longer appears in the catalog.

PATCH /payment-links/{id}.title: Update payment link
PATCH /payment-links/{id}.description: Update title, URLs, checkout fields, expiry, or amount (instant links).

DELETE /payment-links/{id}.title: Archive payment link
DELETE /payment-links/{id}.description: Deactivate a payment link. Existing paid checkouts stay.

DELETE /coupons/{id}.title: Delete coupon
DELETE /coupons/{id}.description: Delete a discount coupon from the organization.

GET /team.title: List team
GET /team.description: List members and pending invitations for the current organization.

GET /team/roles.title: List team roles
GET /team/roles.description: List Admin/Member and any custom roles already created.

POST /team/invitations.title: Invite team member
POST /team/invitations.description: Invite by email with Admin/Member or role_id. The human accepts in the browser.

DELETE /team/invitations.title: Revoke team invitation
DELETE /team/invitations.description: Cancel a pending invitation by email.

PATCH /team/members/{memberId}.title: Update team member role
PATCH /team/members/{memberId}.description: Set Admin/Member or assign a custom role_id. You cannot change your own role.

DELETE /team/members/{memberId}.title: Remove team member
DELETE /team/members/{memberId}.description: Remove a member from the organization. You cannot remove yourself.

GET /settings/checkout.title: Get checkout settings
GET /settings/checkout.description: Language, success/cancel URLs, pay button, fee pass-through, analytics, and custom fields.

PATCH /settings/checkout.title: Update checkout settings
PATCH /settings/checkout.description: Pass a settings object with the same fields as Settings → Checkout.

GET /settings/storefront.title: Get storefront settings
GET /settings/storefront.description: Enabled flag, slug, announcement, shipping, and tax config.

PATCH /settings/storefront.title: Update storefront settings
PATCH /settings/storefront.description: Enable/disable the storefront, change slug, announcement, or shipping/tax.

GET /finance/summary.title: Finance summary
GET /finance/summary.description: Cash position, receivables, overdue invoices, upcoming payouts, refunds, and dispute exposure.

GET /finance/cashflow.title: Cashflow
GET /finance/cashflow.description: Daily inflow and outflow over a date range.

GET /finance/aging.title: Receivables aging
GET /finance/aging.description: Open invoice amounts bucketed by days past due.

GET /finance/reconcile.title: Reconcile
GET /finance/reconcile.description: Difference between completed transaction net and completed payouts.

GET /payout-methods.title: List payout methods
GET /payout-methods.description: List destination accounts for withdrawals. Account numbers are masked.

POST /payout-methods.title: Add payout method
POST /payout-methods.description: Register a bank, SPI, or mobile money destination for payouts.
